evidence.title: GitHub - agmmnn/tauri-ui: 🦀 Tauri + shadcn/ui app scaffolder with desktop-ready defaults and optional batteries. Supports: Vite, Next.js, Astro, TanStack Start. · GitHub

name: tauri-ui
summary: CLI that scaffolds Tauri desktop apps with shadcn/ui, desktop-ready defaults and optional batteries.
description: A scaffolder for Tauri desktop apps that adds the native shell and desktop-ready defaults on top of the upstream create-tauri-app and shadcn CLIs; you choose Vite, Next.js, React Router, Astro or TanStack Start. Defaults remove the startup flash, route external links to the system browser and disable overscroll; optional batteries add a starter dashboard, a Rust invoke example, a smaller binary and a GitHub Actions release workflow, plus a dev-only debug panel on Cmd/Ctrl+D.
contains: CLI create-tauri-ui scaffolds Tauri apps with shadcn/ui
frontend options: Vite, Next.js, React Router, Astro, TanStack Start
desktop defaults: no startup flash, external links in system browser, no overscroll
optional batteries: starter dashboard, Rust invoke example, ~65% smaller binary, GitHub Actions release workflow
debug panel on Cmd/Ctrl+D: app state, route, window, invokes, events, plugin logs, diagnostics
no forks of upstream shadcn or create-tauri-app; upstream stays up to date
